name: MyShop
headline: From a good find to a saved order.
summary: A branded Flutter commerce demo connecting discovery, account-scoped favorites and carts, saved delivery addresses, sandbox checkout and private order history.
teaser: A considered storefront, with the commerce behind it.
roleDetail: Implemented the customer shopping journeys and MyShop identity, introduced feature and repository boundaries, integrated Firebase REST services, and added regression checks and native demo delivery.
contributions: Connected browsing, search, saved products, delivery options and order review into a complete mobile journey.
Built persistent account-scoped carts and kept customer discovery separate from seller-managed catalog state.
Implemented hosted MyFatoorah Sandbox checkout with verified results, saved-attempt recovery and duplicate-order protection.
Applied a shared identity across app icons, native launch, onboarding and the storefront, including reduced-motion support.
Added Flutter shopping-journey checks, Firebase ownership-rule tests and CI for native demo builds.
flows: Find your next favorite
Explore categories, search, sort and filter by price or availability. Inspect product galleries, stock states and saved items.
Make it yours
Build a basket that persists per account, adjust quantities, reuse saved addresses, choose delivery and review promotions and totals.
Complete and return
Place a Cash on Delivery demo order or use hosted Sandbox checkout, then return to private order history, purchased items and the delivery timeline.
engineering: Account boundaries
Cart storage uses a separate key for each account and serialized writes. Favorites have pending guards, rollback and protection against late refreshes. Account changes reset secondary navigation.
Payment recovery

The app restores a saved invoice attempt, checks payment status on return or manual retry, and verifies invoice identity, reference, amount, currency and Paid status before saving one demo order. Conditional writes guard against duplicates.
Replaceable integrations

Provider controllers depend on domain entities and repository contracts. Firebase Auth and Realtime Database REST mapping, local storage and payment adapters sit behind implementations; the architecture migration remains incremental.
Evidence and delivery

Flutter CI runs analysis, journey/regression checks and Android/iOS builds. Firebase rules are tested in an emulator. Automated journeys use fake HTTP data; build success does not establish live-device payment acceptance.
boundary: An independent portfolio demo with sample catalog content and demo orders. MyFatoorah Sandbox uses a virtual 1 KWD invoice separate from the EGP basket, with no real charges or deliveries. Delivery stages are illustrative; inventory is checked but not reserved atomically. The showcased version is on the public development branch (PR #18). The downloadable Android build is an ARM64 demo pre-release; physical iOS installation requires Apple signing.

name: Mingle
headline: A little hello can go a long way.
summary: A warm Flutter messaging experience with real iOS simulator captures, thoughtful chat states and a growing NestJS/PostgreSQL backend. Still under active development.
role: Flutter product design, implementation & backend engineering
roleDetail: Designed and developed the Flutter messaging journey and separately built documented NestJS REST foundations; real iOS simulator imagery shows a recent local build, while custom Flutter–backend integration remains pending.
contributions: Created a cohesive Mingle visual experience with registration, profiles, conversations, discovery and thoughtful empty states.
Provided actual iPhone simulator screenshots and two running-app recordings for an honest product walkthrough.
Organized Flutter auth/chat into feature-first architecture with repository contracts and Cubit state management.
Implemented NestJS/PostgreSQL authentication, user discovery, direct conversations, durable messages and read/edit/delete REST flows.
flows: Say hello
Launch, sign-in, account creation and profile setup in the supplied local simulator captures.
Find your people
Discover people, browse a populated chat list and understand unread and empty states.
Keep the conversation going
Real iOS footage shows one-to-one messages, while the version-controlled Flutter client has a separate legacy Firebase adapter.
engineering: A design that feels alive
Pastel visual language and gentle illustrations are demonstrated in actual simulator captures and walkthrough clips.
Durable messaging foundations
NestJS REST API, PostgreSQL migrations, conversation membership, sender idempotency, pagination and durable read pointers.
Clear integration boundary
The custom REST/realtime adapters and Socket.IO transport are not merged into the Flutter app yet; repo status documents the next checkpoint.
boundary: In development. Screens and video are owner-supplied captures of a recent local simulator build, not proof that the new screens are merged into current GitHub master. The Flutter client still uses legacy Firebase messaging. NestJS REST and PostgreSQL are implemented separately; Socket.IO realtime transport and custom Flutter backend integration remain pending. No public APK or production chat service is claimed.
